themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and act upon them.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI applications and platforms designed to support and enhance research processes.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated user data for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, providing key insights.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates how AI is changing job roles, recruitment, skills, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers AI applications and techniques used to inform and enhance the design process for products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare the capabilities and performance of different AI tools for research.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being used to assist in or conduct qualitative research methods, such as interviews and analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research and findings related to the use, behavior, and impact of AI chatbots.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
